title: Cash Payout of Credit Value — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
Value held on Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers is paid out in cash in two situations only.

**Situation one — involuntary-origin refund.** A credit issued on the ground of involuntary cancellation or of a refund alternative is refunded in full to the original form of payment on request, where its instrument makes involuntary-origin credits refundable. This is because the customer was entitled to a refund when the credit was issued. The payout equals the remaining value, and any choose-credit bonus included in it is removed first.

**Situation two — cash exchange of an accepted voucher.** An accepted voucher whose instrument permits cash exchange may be exchanged for cash within the cash-exchange window. The cash paid is the instrument's cash-exchange percentage of the remaining value, rounded to the cent. In words, the cash paid is the remaining value multiplied by the cash-exchange percentage, divided by one hundred, and rounded to the nearest cent.

**Cash-exchange window.** A cash exchange must be requested no later than the instrument's cash-exchange window in calendar days after the voucher was issued. The window is counted in calendar days from the issue date, and a request on the last day is accepted. The issue date the system records for this voucher is the evidence.

**Payout entry.** A refund payout is booked only on a credit whose status is refunded.

**Processing.** Cash refunds are processed within the instrument's refund processing period in business days.

**Non-refundable credit.** Every other credit is non-refundable. A partly used credit is refunded only for its remaining value, and a voluntary-cancellation or residual credit is never paid out in cash.

## Grounds and outcomes

| Credit | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Involuntary cancellation or refund alternative, on an instrument whose involuntary-origin credits are refundable | Remaining value refunded to the original form of payment, less any choose-credit bonus included in it |
| Accepted voucher on an instrument permitting cash exchange, requested within the window | Cash of the stated percentage of the remaining value, rounded to the cent |
| Voluntary cancellation credit or residual credit | Never paid out in cash |

## Hypothetical figures

- *Window.* A voucher issued on 10 March 2026 with a 30-day window may be exchanged on a request made up to and including 9 April 2026. A request on 10 April 2026 is outside the window.
- *Cash exchange.* At 80 percent, a remaining value of 150.00 US dollars pays 120.00 in cash.
- *Bonus removed.* An unused refund-alternative credit of 550.00 US dollars that includes a 50.00 choose-credit bonus pays out 500.00.
